source_refs.note: Topic 1.8 IP Addressing and Subnetting as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 15, printed 10); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: An IP address is a unique number assigned to a device. IP stands for Internet Protocol. It helps identify devices on a network. Data uses IP addresses to find its destination. Every network device must have an IP address. Communication is not possible without it.
